basic_info.description: Steps from Glen Canyon Park's trails, playgrounds, and tennis courts, 25 Mizpah Street blends historic San Francisco architecture with thoughtful contemporary updates. This 4-bedroom, 3-bath Victorian bungalow offers a flexible two-level floor plan plus a fully equipped lower level designed for today's lifestyle.    The main level features a fireplace-accented living room and a light-filled kitchen/dining area that flows onto a sun-soaked deck for effortless indoor-outdoor living. Upstairs, two en-suite bedrooms include a spacious primary suite with spa-inspired bath and steam shower.    The lower level adds versatility with two additional bedrooms, a full bath, laundry, and storageideal for guests, work-from-home, or extended family.    Original hardwood floors, large windows, and preserved period details bring warmth and authenticity, while modern upgrades ensure everyday comfort. A one-car garage and driveway parking for multiple vehicles add exceptional convenience. Near Glen Park Village, Diamond Street, the recreation center, and key transit lines including Muni and Glen Park BART, this home offers the perfect blend of neighborhood tranquility and city connectivity.
